verdicts.reason: A is just the square shrunk into the middle of the banner: wide dead areas on both sides, a tiny logo, an unreadable SOLSTICE label and a CTA label only a few pixels tall. B does rebuild the layout left to right with a big, readable headline, but it is still broken. The panel runs off the left and bottom edges, an empty brown band sits above it, the CTA is jammed against the right edge and almost touches 'glow', the logo is stranded at the bottom left under the can, and the can label is illegible. B is the less bad of the two.
